name: 74126 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74126 (Tulsa) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74126 (Tulsa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74126 (Tulsa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
